intent_rules.decision_rule: Microinverter class confirmed by source; compact box/connectors visible. Enphase is on an installation rail, not yet covered by its panel.
Closed wall-mounted inverter photographs. Excludes open inverter, standalone/rail-mounted microinverters, station enclosures and MPPT charge controller.
Visible blue capacitors/PCBs; source confirms inverter. Open breaker cabinets are negatives.

All three show inverter units installed with photovoltaic panels directly above/behind; panel backs/racking are visible in central-inverter crop e002. Enphase e003 is before its panel is placed; handheld e007 is not installed.
Visible internal switchgear/PLC/breaker/terminal wiring. An opened inverter is not a distribution/control cabinet; socket boxes with closed covers excluded.
Switchgear rows on both sides with a central aisle. Single open cabinets and datacenter UPS rows are different equipment classes.

At least bushings or radiator fins visible, class supported by source. CERN red transformer housings e023 and locked ventilated transformer enclosure e024 hide these attributes; both are negative for this specific query.
Tower, socket-strip and datacenter UPS are relevant; source confirms UPS role. Solar inverter/charge controller are not computer UPS positives.
